theme: 3 terms on turning values into JSON: the Foundation encoder, the setting that sorts or pretty prints the output, and the setting that decides how dates are written

terms.definition: A Foundation class that turns an `Encodable` value into JSON data.
terms.example: Use one JSONEncoder for the whole API client, so every request looks the same.

terms.definition: An encoder setting that changes how the JSON text looks, like sorted keys or pretty printing.
terms.example: Turn on sorted keys in Output Formatting, or the snapshot diff is pure noise.

terms.definition: An encoder setting that decides how a `Date` is written in JSON, like a number or text.
terms.example: The backend wants text dates, so change the Date Encoding Strategy.

Learn to explain JSON encoding settings in Swift: JSONEncoder, Output Formatting & Date Encoding Strategy, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
JSONEncoder - A Foundation class that turns an `Encodable` value into JSON data.
Output Formatting - An encoder setting that changes how the JSON text looks, like sorted keys or pretty printing.
Date Encoding Strategy - An encoder setting that decides how a `Date` is written in JSON, like a number or text.

landscape.title: Swift JSONEncoder, Output Formatting & Date Encoding Strategy | Day 76
landscape.description:
Explain JSONEncoder, Output Formatting & Date Encoding Strategy in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
JSONEncoder, 출력 형식, 날짜 인코딩 전략 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

JSONEncoder - A Foundation class that turns an `Encodable` value into JSON data.
한국어: JSONEncoder: `Encodable` 값을 JSON 데이터로 바꿔 주는 Foundation 클래스

Output Formatting - An encoder setting that changes how the JSON text looks, like sorted keys or pretty printing.
한국어: 출력 형식: 키 정렬이나 보기 좋은 들여쓰기처럼 JSON 텍스트의 모양을 바꾸는 인코더 설정

Date Encoding Strategy - An encoder setting that decides how a `Date` is written in JSON, like a number or text.
한국어: 날짜 인코딩 전략: `Date`를 JSON에 숫자로 쓸지 문자열로 쓸지 정하는 인코더 설정

In this video, Mina and Jake find out why the server gets a date as a huge number, where that number starts counting and why a snapshot test kept failing, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Why is our date a huge number? Can you explain it in English?

dialogue.title: Why is the date a number?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the backend team says `at` arrives as a huge number.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's the default Date Encoding Strategy: seconds since 2001.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yep, Apple's reference date. The server wants ISO 8601 text.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So I change the Date Encoding Strategy to ISO 8601?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And why is Output Formatting already set?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: For sorted keys. Without it, JSONEncoder doesn't promise any key order.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, that's why our snapshot test kept failing!

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. That Output Formatting makes the same event give the same JSON.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. One JSONEncoder, ISO dates, and sorted keys.
Share one JSONEncoder, so every request is encoded the same way.
